text:
Alexa: Quick heads-up — planning a compact 'Dev Workshop: Build with OSS RefApp' next Thurs. Goal: launch short tutorial, a small benchmark narrative (latency/cost), and a 45-min live walkthrough. Need owners for: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar landing + routing, speaker copy and social snippets.
Maria: I can draft the launch post + short social thread. Would love a hook — lean into "ship faster with predictable inference costs" :rocket:
Josh: I'll handle the benchmark narrative and perf slides. Plan to include 3 workload profiles (chat, summarization, embeddings) and a one-slide cost/latency tradeoff.
Takahashi: I'll own the webinar landing page + signup form. Can route inbound to HubSpot with tags. Need the speaker list + short bios by Tue.
Sophie: I'll pull speaker bios and short headshots. Also can do 2 variant subject lines for the invite.
Lia: For inbound routing, recommend: utm_source=dev-workshop, utm_campaign=oss-refapp, hubspot_list=dev-workshop-2024. Also propose an automated email flow 24h before + reminder 1h prior.
devrel-bot: Created calendar 'Dev Workshop — OSS RefApp' on 2024-03-14 16:00 UTC and a draft event page: https://tiny.redwood/event/oss-workshop
Maria: Draft social copy v1 below — feedback? 
```
New mini workshop: Build a reference app with Redwood Inference and measure real cost vs latency. Wed 14 Mar • 45m
Sign up: https://tiny.redwood/event/oss-workshop
Join us to get a ready-to-run tutorial, a live perf demo, and a community Q&A. #oss #mlinfra
``` 
Takahashi: Looks good. Add one line about 'live benchmark' to entice infra folks.
Maria: Updated social copy v2: "...live perf demo + mini-benchmark". Also drafted a short blog intro — dropping in the doc: https://tiny.redwood/doc/mini-workshop
Josh: For the benchmark narrative, I want a 3-panel layout: setup, results, takeaways. I'll write the 'results' and Maria can add a callout on 'how to reproduce' for the tutorial.
Sophie: Speakers confirmed: Josh (perf), Maria (devrel), Lina (customer), me (moderator). Lina needs a short brief — can someone create bullet points for talking about 'cost savings'?
Lia: I'll map the inbound leads: Tag=workshop, Journey=workshop-nurture, LeadOwner=devrel. Do we want to auto-create tasks for reps on high-intent leads? :thinking:
Alexa: Yes — auto-task for leads with 'interested-demo' checkbox. Deadline: M/T center to have landing copy and social copy by EOD Tue. Webinar slides and benchmark draft by Wed EOD.
Maria: I'll post the launch thread in #general and schedule the first social blast. Who's scheduling the follow-ups?
Takahashi: I'll schedule the HubSpot sequence, Lia will configure tagging and tasks.
Sophie: I'll prep speaker notes and a 1-pager. Ping me when bios are live.
Josh: I'll upload perf graphs by Wed noon — CSV + notebook link will be in the doc.
Alexa: Awesome. Quick checklist: 
- Maria: launch post + social copy (owner)
- Josh: benchmark narrative + slides (owner)
- Takahashi: landing + signup + routing (owner)
- Lia: HubSpot tagging & automation (owner)
- Sophie: speaker assets + 1-pager (owner)
Let's reconvene Wed 11:00 UTC for a final pre-launch sync. :calendar:
Lia: noted, I'll add the sync to the calendar and tag the thread when done. :white_check_mark:
Maria: Copy scheduled for Tue 17:00 PST. I'll post here when done.
devrel-bot: HubSpot form created: https://tiny.redwood/form/12345
Alexa: Thanks team — this looks ship-ready. Keep updates short in this thread so we can track progress. :memo:
